title: XSE Execution Intent
description: Strict JSON schema for bounded trade execution requests processed by the XCron Sovereign Enclave. Invalid requests must fail loudly.

source_asset.description: The base asset used to fund the trades (e.g., USDT, USDC)

asset.description: The target asset to buy or sell (e.g., ETH, BTC)

max_quote_amount.description: Maximum amount of the source_asset to spend

constraints.description: Hard limits for the execution engine. Any breach of these constraints aborts the entire batch.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 strict expiration. Enclave will reject if current time > expires_at

allowed_assets.description: Whitelist of assets this intent is allowed to touch.

allow_withdrawals.description: Must be strictly false for trade intents. Prevents malicious API key extraction.

client_reference_id.description: Unique idempotent ID provided by the client (e.g., Fluxa) for reconciliation and replay protection.
